notes: «قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» is Salama's question, and the Imam's answer «أَلا قُلْتَ لَهُ» is the saying: the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ العِجْلِيّةِ قالَ لي» is a speaker inside the story, not a transmitter: left out
The leading «20 - نَصٌّ آخَرُ» is an editor's note and is left out
